features.name: Dev container script for AL development
features.description: Building a dev container configuration with Ubuntu base image to provide Cloud Code installation and authentication, with plans to restrict dangerous command execution within the container.
caveats: Authentication method still being determined
Requires WSL compatibility testing
Bypass permission flag used only in development

features.name: Claude voice prompting in development workflow
features.description: Using voice transcription with Whisper to input prompts to Claude instead of typing, allowing verbal specification of development requirements.

features.name: Bypass permission flag for Cloud Code
features.description: A dangerously flag that removes the need to manually approve every command Cloud Code wants to execute, enabling automated setup but at security risk outside containers.
caveats: Dangerous in non-sandboxed environments
Should only be used within dev containers

features.name: Claude agent sub-agent task delegation
features.description: Built-in capability for Claude to spawn sub-agents to research specific topics and handle complex subtasks autonomously based on unstructured prompts.
caveats: Limited visibility into background sub-agent work

features.name: Opus configuration for thorough analysis
features.description: Option to configure Claude Opus for more careful and thorough analysis over speed, accepting longer completion times for higher accuracy on first attempt.

features.name: Interactive Claude prompting within sessions
features.description: Claude can ask users interactive questions during task completion without interrupting the main session, allowing real-time refinement of requirements.

features.name: Dockerfile generation for dev containers
features.description: Claude generated a Dockerfile based on Ubuntu with Cloud Code installation, path configuration, dev container JSON settings, and environment variable binding.

features.name: WSL Windows compatibility verification
features.description: Claude verified that the generated dev container bindings and environment key setup are compatible with Windows Subsystem for Linux without requiring changes.

features.name: Dev Container Feature
features.description: Cloud Code suggested using dev container features to distribute Docker, Docker CLI, and GitHub CLI in a composable way, offering a recommended approach for sharing development environment configurations.
caveats: Local file system path resolution issues encountered
Authentication did not pass through correctly with Dockerfile approach
GitHub Actions release workflow did not run successfully

features.name: Dev Container CLI
features.description: A command-line interface tool for managing dev containers, discovered during the setup process for testing container configurations locally and with GitHub URLs.

features.name: Cloud Code authentication persistence in dev containers
features.description: Cloud Code login credentials do not persist across dev container rebuilds; users must re-authenticate each time they start a new session, even with the same container configuration.
caveats: Authentication does not persist between container sessions
Initial setup requires selecting theme and logging in

features.name: Mounted docker volume for shared AL development configuration
features.description: Strategy to mount a dedicated docker volume for AL-specific Cloud Code configuration that is shared across dev containers, avoiding need to authenticate repeatedly and centralizing AL development settings.
caveats: Approach is still being evaluated
Need to verify if authentication can be mounted correctly
Requires single authentication within container to persist

features.name: User-level AL development instructions in Cloud Code
features.description: Proposed architecture separating user-level instructions specific to AL development from project-specific instructions, avoiding duplication of AL development guidance across multiple projects.

features.name: Voice recording to clipboard shortcut
features.description: A shortcut that records voice, runs it through Whisper, and pastes the transcribed text to clipboard for use in any application.

features.name: Docker volume for dev container authentication
features.description: A shared docker volume approach to handle authentication credentials across multiple dev containers, avoiding separate authentication in each container.
caveats: requires mounting .local/share/cloud folder
cloud code may write files to other directories not captured

features.name: Cloud Code dev container configuration
features.description: Testing mounting of .local/share/cloud folder to persist authentication and configuration across dev container rebuilds.
caveats: authentication still requires manual onboarding after rebuild
cloud code does not properly persist all authentication state

features.name: Cloud Code authorization callback
features.description: Manual authorization flow for cloud code involving URL copying, code exchange, and manual entry since automatic callback does not work reliably.
caveats: callback mechanism does not work
requires manual URL copying and code pasting

features.name: Cloud trace JSON authentication storage
features.description: Investigation into whether cloud trace JSON file contains authentication information and exploration of mounting authentication separately from other configuration files.
caveats: cloud trace JSON does not directly contain authentication information
authentication stored in separate location not yet identified

features.name: AL-specific directory mounting
features.description: A planned enhancement to mount an AL-specific directory within the dev container that keeps cloud code configuration separate from general home directory files.
features.status_evidence_quote: cloud AL specific directory will be the next thing

features.name: Git remote sanitization for dev containers
features.description: A security approach to remove GitHub remote URLs from git repositories in dev containers to protect against potential code destruction if cloud code malfunctions while disconnected from the remote.
caveats: Approach is still exploratory and may need refinement

features.name: Git credential stripping in dev containers
features.description: Removing Git credentials from the dev container while keeping them persistent on the host machine, preventing them from being passed into the container.
caveats: credential stripping implementation appears incomplete as pull and push still worked after removal

features.name: Sudo support in dev container post-start commands
features.description: Ability to run sudo commands during the dev container post-start phase, with consideration for the - dangerously-bypass-all-permission flag.
caveats: unclear if this is an intended or supported approach

features.name: Anthropic dev container template
features.description: A pre-built dev container from Anthropic designed for Claude Code setup that could serve as a base for AL development environments.
caveats: not currently being used in this setup; unclear why

features.name: AL development commands in Docker container
features.description: Plans to build AL compile command, publish command, and run tests command baked into a Docker container for a complete ready-to-go AL development environment.
caveats: Still in development, described as part one of a two-part series

features.name: Two-part dev container series
features.description: The presenter plans to continue building a complete AL development dev container as a multi-part video series, with the first part already available on GitHub.
caveats: Plans subject to presenter's availability
